description: This file contains utility functions related to QUIC protocol, specifically for MASQUE support, including version support, configuration, mode string conversion, and Linux-specific TUN interface creation.

methods.name: MasqueSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns supported MASQUE versions supporting IETF QUIC, excluding QUICv2.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a QUIC configuration with max packet size set for MASQUE encapsulation.

methods.name: MasqueModeToString
methods.description: Converts a MasqueMode enum to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const MasqueMode&)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a MasqueMode to an output stream.

methods.name: CreateTunInterface
methods.description: Creates a Linux TUN interface with specified client address and server flag; returns file descriptor or -1 if unsupported or failed.
